description: This file implements the persistence layer for saved or bookmarked news articles in a Flutter application. It manages database initialization, fallback to in-memory storage, and provides methods to save, delete, and retrieve articles.

classes.name: SavedNewsDb
classes.description: A class that handles storing news articles in a local database or in-memory fallback.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the database or activates in-memory fallback if initialization fails.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Saves or updates an article in the database or in-memory store.

methods.name: deleteByHeadline
methods.description: Removes an article identified by its headline.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all saved articles, ordered by recency.
